title: Design System: Khady Sène, carte composite

footer-name.purpose: The name across the foot of the page; letters rise on reveal. Decorative.

loader-name.purpose: The name on the opening screen; 40vw, one word per line under 640px.

display.purpose: Section titles (Book, Parcours, Booking), uppercase, letters rise from their line on reveal.

ticker.purpose: Services ticker on the seamless, filled and outlined words alternating.

loader-count.purpose: The 0-100 count on the opening screen, tabular.

band.purpose: The reverse 'Demander un booking' marquee band.

display-card.purpose: The name on the card front, in container units; one line at 23.5cqw in portrait.

display-card-back.purpose: The name on the card back; hidden in portrait.

wordmark.purpose: The name in header and footer.

numeral.purpose: Front measurements, tabular lining figures, count up on first view; clamp(18px, 3.8cqh, 26px) in portrait. Units at 0.42em (floor 11px) in Pencil Grey.

numeral-back.purpose: Full stats on the card back; 18px in portrait.

card-role.purpose: Descriptor under the card name; clamp(13px, 2.6cqh, 15px) in portrait.

card-agency.purpose: Agency line on the card; 13px in portrait.

card-button.purpose: Buttons inside the card, min height max(44px, 7.4cqh); 14px in the portrait front row.

card-button-small.purpose: Small buttons inside the card, min height max(40px, 6cqh).

card-contact.purpose: Contact lines on the card back.

card-label.purpose: Measurement labels on the card front, Pencil Grey; 11px in portrait.

card-label-back.purpose: Measurement labels on the card back.

lead.purpose: Section introductions, max 34em; rise line by line on reveal.

body-list.purpose: Career entries, max 38em, rank by weight; 1.0625rem under 640px.

body.purpose: Running text and mobile menu links; 1rem under 640px.

label.purpose: Buttons; filters and polaroid captions at 500.

label-small.purpose: Nav links, small header button, field labels (600), book captions, polaroid hint, footer text, viewer caption, booking status, pointer tag.

caption.purpose: Field errors (500, Proof Red) and the booking note (Pencil Grey).

caption-small.purpose: Contact labels on the seamless; filter counts use the same ratio as 0.8125em.

meta.purpose: Opening screen caption; review bar text and button (700) at the same size.

slug.purpose: Print slug under the card; 12px under 640px.

proof-tag.purpose: Provisional layer only: 'Photo provisoire' tags and zone labels.

floor.purpose: Minimum for any scaled text: portrait card labels, units, inline proof tags via max(11px, ...).

shadows.name: field-ring
shadows.purpose: Thickens a field border on focus; a border, not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)
motion.purpose: CSS state transitions: press scale, nav underline, filter underline, menu panel, viewer.

motion.name: press
motion.value: transform: scale(0.97) over 160ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Active state of buttons and chips.

motion.name: color-state
motion.value: 160-180ms ease (300ms on the booking band)
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border changes on hover and selection.

motion.name: gate-motion
motion.value: gsap.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)')
motion.purpose: Both motion layers run only here; otherwise no opening screen, no Lenis, no GSAP, card faces stacked.

motion.name: gate-pointer
motion.value: (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) and (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)
motion.purpose: Card tilt, pointer square, rolling links, magnetic buttons, parcours preview, polaroid dragging.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.value: Lenis lerp 0.11; anchor scrolls 1.3-1.4s, back to top 1.8s
motion.purpose: Page scroll and in-page links.

motion.name: opening-screen
motion.value: chars yPercent 110 to 0, 1s, stagger 0.04, power4.out; count and bar 0 to 100 over 1.6s power2.inOut; exit chars to -110 (0.6s power3.in) then clipPath inset(0 0 100% 0) over 1s power4.inOut
motion.purpose: Once per session (sessionStorage); 6s fallback if scripts fail.

motion.name: develop-reveal
motion.value: clipPath inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0), 1.25-1.3s power4.out, image scale 1.25-1.3 to 1-1.12 over 1.7-1.8s
motion.purpose: Photos develop bottom-up (card front, book shots, card back after 90 degrees, viewer image at 0.85s).

motion.name: letters-rise
motion.value: SplitText chars yPercent 110 to 0, 1.05-1.1s power4.out, stagger 0.03-0.035, line mask
motion.purpose: Card name, display titles, footer name.

motion.name: lines-rise
motion.value: SplitText lines yPercent 105 to 0, 0.95s power3.out, stagger 0.08, line mask
motion.purpose: Section intro paragraphs and leads.

motion.name: text-lift
motion.value: y 22 to 0, opacity 0 to 1, 0.9s power3.out, stagger 0.07
motion.purpose: Filters, facts, sub-heads, contacts, back-to-top.

motion.name: count-up
motion.value: 0 to value, 1.3s power3.out
motion.purpose: Measurements on each card face when first shown.

motion.name: card-flip
motion.value: rotationY 0 to 180, power2.inOut, scrubbed 0.7, scale dip to 0.93
motion.purpose: Pinned comp card turning over on scroll.

motion.name: card-tilt
motion.value: quickTo rotationY up to 5deg, rotationX up to 4deg (perspective 1400), portrait counter-shift up to 12px x / 8px y, 0.9s power3
motion.purpose: Card leans toward the pointer; portrait in counter-parallax.

motion.name: book-depth
motion.value: inner image yPercent -5 to 5 scrubbed; skewY clamped to 3deg from scroll velocity, 0.5s power3
motion.purpose: Book prints drift and lean with scroll.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: xPercent loop 32s (ticker) / 28s reversed (booking band), timeScale 1-6 from scroll velocity, settles over 0.8s
motion.purpose: Ticker and booking band.

motion.name: polaroid-drop
motion.value: y -240 to 0 from rotations -14/10/-9/13deg, 1.15s back.out(1.3), stagger 0.12
motion.purpose: Polaroids dropped onto the seamless.

motion.name: polaroid-throw
motion.value: Draggable x,y bounded to the band, InertiaPlugin; press scale 1.06 rotation 0; release random within 9deg, 0.7s back.out(2)
motion.purpose: Prints handled like loose paper.

motion.name: pointer-square
motion.value: quickTo x/y 0.35s power3; size 14 / 40 / 84px over 0.35s power3.out
motion.purpose: Difference-blend pointer that becomes 'Voir' or 'Lancer'.

motion.name: letter-roll
motion.value: chars yPercent 0 to -100, 0.45s power3.inOut, stagger 0.018
motion.purpose: Nav links and back-to-top on hover.

motion.name: magnetic
motion.value: follow 30% x / 40% y, 0.5s power3.out; press 0.96; leave elastic.out(1, 0.35) over 0.8s
motion.purpose: Primary action buttons.

motion.name: cv-preview
motion.value: quickTo x/y 0.6s power3; in opacity 1 scale 1 random tilt within 4deg 0.45s; image scale 1.2 to 1 0.7s; out scale 0.85 0.3s
motion.purpose: Year photo following the pointer in the parcours.

motion.name: progress-lines
motion.value: scaleX / scaleY 0 to 1 scrubbed (0.3 reading, 0.4 parcours)
motion.purpose: Reading-progress line and parcours line.

motion.name: header-hide
motion.value: yPercent 0 / -100, 0.4s, after 400px
motion.purpose: Header hides on scroll down, returns on scroll up.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all GSAP, Lenis and the opening screen; faces stack
motion.purpose: Accessibility floor.

narrative.northStar: The Comp Card on the Seamless
narrative.overview:
The site is a printed working object photographed in a studio: one white matte card, with printer's crop marks at its corners, lying on a black seamless. Everything on the page is either that black ground or a piece of white stock placed on it: the card itself, the polaroids, the booking slip. The palette is achromatic so the photographs carry all the colour. Depth comes from paper on black, never from shadow.

Type is a single family, Sofia Sans, in three widths. The name and section titles are set in Extra Condensed capitals at poster scale, the measurements in Condensed tabular numerals, and everything else in the regular width in sentence case. The density is a booker's: facts in one look, hairline rules between lines, no ornament.

Motion is one grammar, the print developing, in two layers. The first layer develops the page: crop marks draw out, photos reveal from the bottom with a slow scale settle, display letters rise from their line, and the card turns over on scroll. The second layer handles the prints: an opening screen where the name rises and a 0 to 100 count runs before a black curtain lifts, the card tilting toward the pointer, measurements counting up, paragraphs rising line by line, polaroids that can be picked up and thrown, and a giant footer name rising letter by letter. All of it is gated on `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, and everything that follows the pointer is also gated on a fine, hovering pointer. Under reduced motion none of it runs: no opening screen, no smooth scroll, and the two card faces stack.
keyCharacteristics: Black seamless (#000) alternating with near-white card stock; no other ground colours.
One family in three widths; capitals only for the name, section titles, wordmark, ticker and booking band.
Square corners everywhere (0px), 1px hairline rules, no shadows.
Photos in plain rectangular windows with thin stock-coloured gutters.
Print-native devices: crop marks, slug line under the card, polaroids, A5 print stylesheet.
Motion is the print developing: things rise from a mask, reveal bottom-up, or are handled like loose prints.
A yellow review layer marks provisional content and disappears once the client supplies facts.

rules.name: The Photographs Carry the Colour Rule
rules.body: No chromatic colour enters the system outside the photographs. Red is for errors, yellow for provisional marks; neither is decoration.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: A surface is either the black seamless or white stock. Light sections sit on stock; dark sections are seamless and anything placed on them is stock.

rules.name: The Capitals Are the Name Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for the Extra Condensed display width: the name (card, loader, footer), section titles, wordmark, ticker and booking band. Every other line is sentence case.

rules.name: The Rank by Weight Rule
rules.body: Inside a list, rank comes from weight, not size: career entries use one size, with the year at 700 and the lead phrase at 650.

rules.name: The Card Scales as One Rule
rules.body: Text inside the card is sized in container units with a px floor and ceiling, so the card keeps its proportions as one printed object; nothing inside it is sized in rem or vw.

rules.name: The Paper on Black Rule
rules.body: Lift is shown by placing white stock on the seamless, never by casting a shadow. Polaroids sit slightly rotated at rest (about -0.8deg / 0.6deg) and may land at up to ±9deg once thrown, because loose prints do.

dos: Do keep every surface either black seamless or white stock, and place paper objects on the seamless rather than inventing a third ground.
Do set the name and section titles in Sofia Sans Extra Condensed capitals at 620, and everything else in sentence case.
Do set measurements in Sofia Sans Condensed with tabular lining figures, units smaller and in Pencil Grey.
Do keep corners square (0px) and separate content with 1px Hairline rules.
Do size anything inside the card in container units with a px floor and ceiling so it scales as one printed object.
Do pick text sizes from the documented ramp; functional text never drops below 11px.
Do keep motion to the print-developing grammar (rising from a mask, bottom-up reveals, the card turn, prints handled like loose paper) and drop it entirely under reduced motion.
Do gate every pointer-following effect (tilt, pointer square, magnetic buttons, rolling links, parcours preview, dragging) on a fine, hovering pointer.
Do keep the card printable as an A5 front and back.
donts: Don't use drop shadows; depth is paper on black.
Don't round corners on buttons, fields, photos or cards.
Don't introduce chromatic accent colours; colour belongs to the photographs.
Don't use Proof Yellow outside the provisional-content layer, and don't ship that layer once real content arrives.
Don't set body or interface text in capitals.
Don't add a second type family.
